messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Cluster alert -> infer-edge-uk1 kubelet NotReady (3x) across 2 nodes in pool 'infer-edge-uk1'. Auto-evac started. Pager: https://pager.example/INC-2026-4821 :rotating_light:
alex-oncall: on it, ack. Looking at metrics and recent deploys.
emma-support: FYI support is seeing elevated 5xxs for some customers in eu-west-1, opened a ticket for the top 2.
lee-infra: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep infer-edge-uk1` shows node-23 and node-24 NotReady; kubelet restarted on both ~5m ago.
maya-runtime: I'm seeing repeated container restarts on the inference runtime pods on those nodes. Logs show `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION` and a bunch of `OOMKilled` entries.
alex-oncall: paste logs?
maya-runtime: ```
2026-03-16T21:11:02Z runtime: cuda runtime error: out of memory
2026-03-16T21:11:02Z runtime: process exited with status 137
2026-03-16T21:11:05Z kubelet: container runtime reconnecting
2026-03-16T21:11:30Z runtime: cuda: illegal instruction (possible driver mismatch)
```
lee-infra: Also seeing kubelet logs: ```
Mar 16 21:10:58 node-23 kubelet[1234]: E0316 21:10:58 kubelet_node_status.go:72] Error posting node status: unable to get runtime status: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = containerd: connection closed
Mar 16 21:11:04 node-23 systemd: kubelet.service: main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
```
jordan-sre: Could be driver or memory pressure. Past incidents: transient driver updates -> illegal instruction. Any automated daemonset applied recently?
alex-oncall: No recent rollout in edge region in the last 24h. Checked deploys.
lee-infra: I'm cordoning node-23 and node-24 to avoid new pods: `kubectl cordon node-23 node-24`
lee-infra: Starting drain with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` for the in-use pods. ETA ~3-5m to reschedule.
amelia?? (typo)
alex-oncall: :thumbsup: good. Meanwhile scale up fallback pool (infer-fallback-global) by +4 replicas to soak traffic.
maya-runtime: Triggering a quick autoscale on the fallback pool: `kubectl scale deployment/infer-fallback-global --replicas=10`
emma-support: Support update: two customers (acct #1832, #1974) reported 503s; SLA alert triggered. Notified CSMs.
jordan-sre: Monitor KV cache latency — we might see cold-cache churn when traffic moves. Watch token throughput and tail latency.
alex-oncall: Routing policy updated to favor eu-west-2 and us-west-1 for new requests. Old connections will drain.
lee-infra: For the nodes, I'm collecting dmesg and driver versions, pushing to gist: https://gist.example/node-23-dmesg. Looks like nvidia driver 525.60 but CUDA runtime expects 11.7 vs 12.0 mismatch?
maya-runtime: That explains illegal instruction. Some containers built against 12.0 are failing on 11.x drivers -> falls back, OOMs during retries.
alex-oncall: Short term mitigations: 1) cordon+drain affected nodes (in progress) 2) scale fallback pool (done) 3) update routing (done) 4) pin runtime to older driver-compatible images for edge (rollback job queued)
lee-infra: Kubelet restarted pods on node-25 to pick up new scheduling, node-25 is Ready and taking traffic.
amma?? (typo)
alex-oncall: Any customer-facing rollback we need?
emma-support: For the two impacted customers we've sent interim msg: "We've routed your traffic to fallback capacity to reduce errors. We'll follow up after remediation." No escalations yet.
jordan-sre: Suggest we bubble this to infra team to coordinate a driver patch for the edge fleet; possible rolling reboot with driver update.
lee-infra: Agree. I'll open INFRA-2026-77 and schedule a rolling update window starting in 2h. For immediate relief, I'll mark the affected nodes as unschedulable until patch applied.
maya-runtime: I'll prepare a temporary runtime image that uses cuda 11.7 compatibility shim and start a canary on eu-edge. Will post image tag when ready.
alex-oncall: Current status summary for handoff: affected pool infer-edge-uk1 had 2 nodes NotReady due to kubelet restart triggered by driver/runtime mismatch causing illegal instruction / OOM. Evac in progress, fallback scaled, routing adjusted. Support notified two customers with 503s. Infra will open patch ticket and schedule rolling driver update in 2h. Runtime preparing compat image.
sam-oncall: taking over for overnight. A few action items I want to pick up: 1) confirm driver patch plan (lee) 2) watch fallback latencies and autoscale (maya) 3) keep support comms (emma). I'll be on pager.
alex-oncall: handing off now — I've set the incident channel bookmark and pinned the gist links. Key logs: https://gist.example/node-23-dmesg ; https://gist.example/runtime-ooms.
sam-oncall: ack, thanks. If nodes flip back to NotReady after reboot, escalate to oncall infra lead and consider reprovisioning hardware.
jordan-sre: Adding runbook references: RUNBOOK: Edge-node-kubelet-flap -> https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/kubelet-flap. Follow postmortem template.
emma-support: I'll keep customers updated every 30m until resolved.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> routing and fallback in place. Monitoring for 30m before declaring stable.
sam-oncall: marking as in-progress and assuming pager. Leaving notes in the incident ticket. Good handoff. :white_check_mark:
